Release dates are ALFRED vintage dates (weekdays), which may include a vintage that was not an 08:30 release (annual or benchmark revisions); no date was removed by hand. Before this row was recorded, an implausible first E4b estimate (41 extra trades in 5 minutes) showed that pandas 3 stores these timestamps in microseconds, so int64 / 1e9 shrank time by 1000: the 300 s E4b horizon covered the whole day and the 30-minute gap filter of the E3 realised variance never applied. Both now use exact seconds (common.epoch_seconds). The metric is the registered one; E3a and E3b moved by under 0.12 in mean ratio, and no outcome of E3 changed.
